value.rationale: The complete all-parameter mobility (degree) distribution of a natural *restricted* spanning-tree exchange graph is a structural invariant beyond the classical wheel tree count. It establishes connectivity, exact number of allowed local transformations, sharp extremal mobility, and all degree multiplicities uniformly, providing input for constrained spanning-tree reconfiguration and random local-swap dynamics.
